title: combat_text
summary: MSUI implements world-anchored combat text for the player and owned pet/guardian/totem sources, the four-item per-unit hard cap, miss/dodge/parry/block/absorb/resist words, white player melee and AttributesEx3 bit-15 ranged-basic damage, gold player/pet spells, orange pet melee-styled damage, exact category lifetime/rise/fade/shadow laws, critical pop scaling, XP, and honor gains. Live honor-award verification remains tracked by ui/combattext.

openItems.text: Pet damage never floats: WorldText requires attacker == playerGuid, so an owned pet's hits show nothing - the reference floats pet melee ORANGE (0xFFFF8400) and pet spell GOLD under their own cvars.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: UNIT_FIELD_SUMMONEDBY/CREATEDBY ownership now admits owned melee, spell, periodic, shield, and miss sources; pet melee renders 0xFFFF8400 orange while pet spell damage retains shared gold.

openItems.text: The category timing/scale/fade table is replaced by one flat 1.5 s lifetime: no per-category rise rates, no crit park-and-pop scale animation (~70 px peak settling to 35 px), no plateau/fade-in/fade-out alpha law or shadow law.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: CombatFeedbackLaw now pins category 0-5 lifetime, rise, fade-in, fade-out, shadow, and color presentation, including exact critical 0.1-to-2-to-1 pop scale keyframes and 4500 ms XP/honor paths; focused and regression clinical checks pass.

openItems.text: The ranged-basic-shot exception (AttributesEx3 bit-15 -> Auto Shot/Throw numbers float white off the spell-damage log) is not applied - all spell-log damage styles gold.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: direct and periodic spell-log damage now resolves Spell.dbc AttributesEx3 bit 15 and selects the melee color branch—white for the player and orange for an owned source—with the reference's missing-record fallback; focused combat-wire regression coverage passes.
